description: This source file defines a PHP class 'Special' which is a controller extension for handling special products in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes a method 'index' that loads language files, models, and views to display special products based on certain filter criteria.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for handling special product display in a specific module extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets filter criteria, fetches special products, processes product data (images, prices, taxes), and renders the view for the special products module.
